Current Grid Conditions

East BAA: Currently under Baseline Normal Operating Conditions; Resource Advisory begins Tues., Nov. 24, at at 4 a.m. CT until an anticipated end time of Wed., Nov. 25 at 9 a.m. CT

West BAA: Baseline Normal Operating Conditions

Find a map of SPP’s East and West Balancing Authority Areas below:

Recent Advisories and Alerts:

Monday, November 23, at 5 p.m. CT

SPP is declaring a Resource Advisory for the East Balancing Authority Area (BAA) to take effect Tuesday, November 24, at 4 a.m. CT, until an anticipated end time of Wednesday, November 25, at 9 a.m. CT Resource Advisories are still considered normal operating conditions and do not require the public to conserve energy or take any action, but are issued to raise awareness of potential threats to reliability among entities responsible for operating transmission and generation facilities.

  • This Resource Advisory in SPP’s East BAA is being declared due to potential forecast uncertainty caused by a cold front moving through the region, which creates the potential for higher than normal loads and possible outages. This means demand could potentially be higher than expected due to more people using electricity during peak hours. Forecasts indicate cold temperatures in some areas due to the cold front moving through the region, which causes greater load, especially if cooler temps take place during peak hours. Wind and solar generation could potentially be lower than the expected Variable Energy Resource (VER) forecast. 
  • Individuals should contact their local utility for details specific to their area.
  • SPP generation and transmission operators have been provided instructions on applicable procedures, including reporting any limitations, fuel shortages or concerns.
  • To mitigate risks to reliability associated with these factors, SPP may use greater unit commitment notification timeframes, including making commitments before standard day-ahead market procedures and/or committing resources in reliability status.
  • SPP will send additional information if necessary.

SPP’s West BAA is currently under baseline normal operating conditions.
